alum_apothecary_5 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_3_years
	district_level_requirement = 9
	can_construct_potential = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	}
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
	}
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = alum_apothecary_income_tier_5
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = alum_apothecary_income_tier_5_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_alum_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_alum
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_medicaments_production_add = medicaments_output_from_alum_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_medicament_from_alum_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_medicament_from_alum_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_medicaments }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_alum }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_medicaments }
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}


	next_building = eu5_interior_alum_apothecary_5_discovery
}

	construction_time = construction_time_3_years

	district_level_requirement = 13
	can_construct_potential = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		NOT = {
			has_building_or_higher = tea_house_1
		}
	}
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
		culture = { has_innovation = innovation_eu5_food_advance_absolutism }
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
	}
	cost_gold = eu5_interior_scaled_resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost_3
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = eu5_interior_scaled_jar_packing_workshops_prosperity_tier_5_3
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_tea_buy_price_mult = eu5_interior_scaled_jar_packing_workshops_tea_buy_price_mult_3
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_ceramics
		amount = luxury_resource_need
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = jar_packing_workshops_agricultural_tax_per_ceramics_need
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_agricultural_tax = jar_packing_workshops_agricultural_tax_per_ceramics_need_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_ceramics }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}

lacquerware_workshop_5 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_3_years
	district_level_requirement = 9
	can_construct_potential = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
		culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlock_lacquerware_buildings }
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
	}
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = 0.05
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = resource_tier_10_main_income #Artisan Income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_woodland_tax = resource_tier_10_main_income_tribal
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_dyes_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = { #1
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_lacquerware_production_add = lacquerware_output_per_wood
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_lacquerware_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_woodland_tax = monthly_tax_per_lacquerware_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	#1 dyes
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_dyes
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_lacquerware_production_mult = lacquerware_mult_per_dyes
				woodland_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
